# NFL Daily — 2026-11-05 (Past 1 day(s))

## Summary
- Ravens are finalizing a trade with the Cardinals for QB Jacoby Brissett as Baltimore's quarterback situation unravels. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50381318/sources-ravens-finalizing-trade-cardinals-qb-brissett)
- Vikings turn to Carson Wentz at QB for Monday's game vs. the Bills; Kyler Murray (hamstring) is week-to-week. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2118409054741536789) — also [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50390732/vikings-start-qb-wentz-bills-murray-injured)
- Browns QB Deshaun Watson remains in concussion protocol; Shedeur Sanders is likely to start Sunday vs. the Saints. [Cabot](https://x.com/MaryKayCabot/status/2118404605713481764)
- Packers RB Josh Jacobs addressed new allegations after being accused of abuse by three additional women. [CBS](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/packers-josh-jacobs-addresses-latest-allegations/)
- Colts RB Jonathan Taylor is still awaiting resolution on a possible trade ahead of the deadline. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50390525/colts-rb-jonathan-taylor-awaits-resolution-trade-rumbling)
- Patriots owner Robert Kraft is recovering from back surgery and will miss Rob Gronkowski's Hall of Fame induction Saturday. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50388263/patriots-owner-robert-kraft-recovering-back-surgery)
- Bill Belichick is among five coaching finalists for the Pro Football Hall of Fame's Class of 2027, along with Tom Coughlin, Mike Holmgren, Dan Reeves and Mike Shanahan. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50390130/bill-belichick-5-coaching-candidates-hall-fame)
- Rams CB Jaylen Watson will have season-ending shoulder surgery. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7754404/2026/11/04/jaylen-watson-rams-shoulder-surgery/)
